rules.hn: n exchange sessions after the fill session; fill = H0
rules.schedule: nominal Wednesday signal, rolled back to the prior session if closed; entry is the first session after the signal
rules.exit_convention: final regular-hours minute close, or that session's last regular-hours print when the security did not trade in the final minute
rules.entries: identical certified R2 entries, shares, entry observations and entry costs at every horizon inside a panel
rules.capital: no reinvestment, replacement entry, compounding or exposure normalisation
rules.costs: $0.005/share/side commission and a max($0.01, 0.001*price)/side spread proxy; 0/10/30% annualised borrow scenarios on marked gross by actual calendar days; dividends, locate and financing unknown and null
rules.risk_accounting: IS and OOS metrics come from split-owned books; ALL is a separate view

oos_procedure: one batch revealing every OOS cell of both panels; no post-reveal change

is_interpretation.primary_claimed_benefit: higher in-sample modeled net at the preferred horizon than that family's H10
is_interpretation.tolerable_downside: a preferred horizon is not confirmed if its OOS modeled net is below that family's OOS H10, or if its OOS maximum drawdown is more than 20% worse
is_interpretation.selection_basis: LEGACY_FILL_QTY in-sample only; the causal panel is a robustness view, not a search
is_interpretation.note: ten horizons on one entry ledger are one correlated family, not ten independent discoveries
